steps: 1. Use a hero with at least one career still locked by hero level and open the in-Keep career picker.
2. With the picker still open, switch on **Unlock all careers (owned DLC only)**.
3. Confirm the owned, level-locked careers become selectable immediately, and that careers from downloadable content you do not own stay locked.
4. Switch the setting off and confirm the exact vanilla level locks return immediately, with no career spawned and no profile request sent.
5. Switch it back on, reopen the picker once, run `/crt_regression_test` and attach the log.
assertions: the setting refreshes the already-open picker and bypasses only the hero-level gate on careers you own; unowned downloadable-content careers remain locked because that gate lives upstream of this hook; disabling restores vanilla locks exactly; no profile request or forced career spawn occurs at any point; diagnostics stay bounded. The log must contain `[crt:728] installed setting=<true|false> scope=local_level_gate occupancy=vanilla` at load, `[crt:728] level_gate ...` rows recording the bypass decisions, and a `[crt:728] ui_refresh setting=true hero_summary=... character_select=...` row for the toggle performed with the picker open.
With the picker open toggle the setting: [crt:728] ui_refresh row, level-locked owned career becomes selectable, unowned DLC stays locked, no profile request; C residual: occupancy stays vanilla.
